decisions.choice: I acquire as a wife: marriage as part of a legal agreement
decisions.reason: The same verb is used for the field and for Ruth, because both were part of one agreement. It does not mean Ruth was bought as property; she had chosen Boaz (3:9-10), and the marriage keeps the promise he made her (3:13).

decisions.choice: the name will not be cut off from his brothers and from the gate of his place: he will not be forgotten in his family or his town
decisions.reason: "The gate of his place" is the town where he belonged, its public life gathered at the gate. A man without an heir would vanish from his clan's records and land; Boaz's marriage keeps Mahlon's line in Bethlehem (Deuteronomy 25:6).

decisions.choice: Ruth the Moabite: a foreign woman received into Israel
decisions.reason: Boaz names her as a Moabite in the public record. A law barred Moabites from the LORD's assembly (Deuteronomy 23:4), yet Ruth, who chose Naomi's people and God (1:16), becomes the wife of a leading man of Judah and an ancestor of David (verse 17).

decisions.choice: relatives; hometown
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "relatives" for "brothers" (as in verse 3) and "hometown" for "the gate of his place".

decisions.choice: adquiro (L), estou adquirindo (B); estou recebendo (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "adquirir", the verb used for the field in verse 9, because one agreement covers both (m1); "comprar" would make Ruth sound like property, which the meaning note denies. Readable, which says "comprar" for the land, says "recebendo ... como minha mulher" for Ruth.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ כָּל־הָעָ֧ם אֲשֶׁר־בַּשַּׁ֛עַר וְהַזְּקֵנִ֖ים עֵדִ֑ים יִתֵּן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶֽת־הָאִשָּׁ֜ה הַבָּאָ֣ה אֶל־בֵּיתֶ֗ךָ כְּרָחֵ֤ל׀וּכְלֵאָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנ֤וּ שְׁתֵּיהֶם֙ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַעֲשֵׂה־חַ֣יִל בְּאֶפְרָ֔תָה וּקְרָא־שֵׁ֖ם בְּבֵ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said all the people who [were] at the gate and the elders, witnesses; may make YHWH the woman, the [one] coming into your house, like Rachel and like Leah, who built [the] two of them [the] house of Israel; and make strength in Ephrathah and proclaim [a] name in Bethlehem.

en.L: And all the people who [were] at the gate, and the elders, said, "[We are] witnesses. May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} make the woman who is coming into your house like Rachel and like Leah, the two of whom built the house of Israel. And may you make strength in Ephrathah and proclaim a name in Bethlehem.
en.B: All the people at the gate and the elders answered, "We are witnesses. May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} make the woman who is coming into your home like Rachel and Leah, the two women who built up the family of Israel. May you thrive in Ephrathah and be renowned in Bethlehem.
en.R: Then all the people at the gate and the town leaders said, "Yes, we have seen it. We pray that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make Ruth, who is coming into your home, like Rachel and Leah. Those two women gave Israel its whole family. May you grow strong and rich in Ephrathah, and may your name be famous in Bethlehem.

sw.L: Nao watu wote waliokuwa langoni, na wazee, wakasema, "[Sisi ni] mashahidi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na amfanye mwanamke huyu anayeingia nyumbani mwako kama Raheli na kama Lea, ambao wote wawili waliijenga nyumba ya Israeli. Nawe ujipatie nguvu katika Efrata, na ulitangaze jina huko Bethlehemu.
sw.B: Watu wote waliokuwa langoni na wazee walijibu, "Sisi ni mashahidi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na amfanye mwanamke huyu anayeingia nyumbani mwako kama Raheli na Lea, wanawake wawili walioijenga jamaa ya Israeli. Ufanikiwe katika Efrata na kuwa na sifa huko Bethlehemu.
sw.R: Kisha watu wote waliokuwa langoni na viongozi wa mji walisema, "Ndiyo, tumeona. Tunaomba kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amfanye Ruthu, anayeingia nyumbani mwako, kama Raheli na Lea. Wanawake hao wawili ndio waliompa Israeli jamaa yake yote. Uwe na nguvu na mali katika Efrata, na jina lako lijulikane sana huko Bethlehemu.

es.L: Y todo el pueblo que [estaba] en la puerta, y los ancianos, dijeron: «[Somos] testigos. Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} haga a la mujer que entra en tu casa como a Raquel y como a Lea, las dos que edificaron la casa de Israel. Y que adquieras poder en Efrata y proclames un nombre en Belén.
es.B: Todo el pueblo que estaba en la puerta y los ancianos respondieron: «Somos testigos. Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} haga a la mujer que entra en tu casa como a Raquel y a Lea, las dos que edificaron la familia de Israel. Que prosperes en Efrata y seas famoso en Belén.
es.R: Entonces toda la gente que estaba en la puerta y los líderes del pueblo dijeron: «Sí, lo hemos visto. Le pedimos a {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} que haga a Rut, que entra en tu casa, como a Raquel y a Lea. Esas dos mujeres le dieron a Israel toda su familia. Que te hagas fuerte y rico en Efrata, y que tu nombre sea famoso en Belén.

fr.L: Et tout le peuple qui [était] à la porte, et les anciens, dirent : « [Nous sommes] témoins. Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rende la femme qui entre dans ta maison semblable à Rachel et à Léa, qui toutes deux ont bâti la maison d’Israël. Et toi, acquiers de la force en Éphrata et proclame un nom à Bethléem.
fr.B: Tout le peuple qui se trouvait à la porte, ainsi que les anciens, répondirent : « Nous en sommes témoins. Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rende la femme qui entre dans ta maison semblable à Rachel et à Léa, les deux femmes qui ont bâti la famille d’Israël. Prospère en Éphrata, et que ton nom soit célèbre à Bethléem !
fr.R: Alors tous les gens qui étaient à la porte et les chefs de la ville ont dit : « Oui, nous l’avons vu. Nous prions pour que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rende Ruth, qui entre dans ta maison, semblable à Rachel et à Léa. Ce sont ces deux femmes qui ont donné à Israël toute sa famille. Que tu deviennes fort et riche en Éphrata, et que ton nom soit célèbre à Bethléem !

vi.L: Toàn dân ở tại cổng thành và các trưởng lão nói: "[Chúng tôi là] những người làm chứng. Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho người phụ nữ đang vào nhà ông giống như Ra-chên và như Lê-a, hai người đã xây dựng nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên. Nguyện ông làm nên sức mạnh ở Ép-ra-ta và được nổi danh ở Bết-lê-hem.
vi.B: Toàn dân ở cổng thành và các trưởng lão đáp: "Chúng tôi xin làm chứng. Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho người phụ nữ sắp vào nhà ông được như Ra-chên và Lê-a, là hai người đã gây dựng nên nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên. Nguyện ông được thịnh vượng ở Ép-ra-ta và nổi danh ở Bết-lê-hem.
vi.R: Bấy giờ toàn dân ở cổng thành và các vị lãnh đạo nói: "Vâng, chúng tôi đã chứng kiến. Chúng tôi cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho Ru-tơ, người sắp vào nhà ông, được như Ra-chên và Lê-a. Hai bà ấy đã sinh ra cả dân tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên. Nguyện ông được mạnh mẽ và giàu có ở Ép-ra-ta, và nổi danh ở Bết-lê-hem.

ko.L: 성문에 있던 모든 백성과 장로들이 말했다. "[우리가] 증인이오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 당신의 집에 들어가는 그 여자를, 둘이서 이스라엘의 집을 세운 라헬과 레아처럼 되게 하시기를 바라오. 당신이 에브랏에서 힘을 떨치고 베들레헴에서 이름을 높이기를 바라오.
ko.B: 성문에 있던 모든 백성과 장로들이 대답했다. "우리가 증인이오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 당신의 집에 들어오는 그 여자를, 이스라엘 집안을 일으킨 두 여인 라헬과 레아처럼 되게 해 주시기를 바라오. 당신이 에브랏에서 번성하고 베들레헴에서 이름을 떨치기를 바라오.
ko.R: 그러자 성문에 있던 모든 사람과 지도자들이 말했다. "그렇소, 우리가 보았소. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 당신의 집에 들어오는 룻을 라헬과 레아처럼 되게 해 주시기를 기도하오. 그 두 여인에게서 이스라엘의 온 집안이 나왔소. 당신이 에브랏에서 힘 있고 부유해지며, 베들레헴에서 이름을 널리 떨치기를 바라오.

pt.L: E todo o povo que [estava] à porta, e os anciãos, disseram: "[Somos] testemunhas. Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} faça a mulher que está entrando na sua casa como Raquel e como Lia, as duas que edificaram a casa de Israel. E que você conquiste valor em Efrata e torne [o seu] nome conhecido em Belém.
pt.B: Todo o povo que estava à porta e os anciãos responderam: "Somos testemunhas. Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} faça a mulher que está entrando na sua casa como Raquel e Lia, as duas mulheres que formaram a família de Israel. Que você cresça em valor em Efrata e tenha renome em Belém.
pt.R: Então todo o povo que estava à porta e os líderes da cidade disseram: "Sim, nós vimos. Pedimos que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} faça Rute, que está entrando na sua casa, ser como Raquel e Lia. Aquelas duas mulheres deram a Israel toda a sua família. Que você fique forte e rico em Efrata, e que o seu nome seja famoso em Belém.

am.L: በበሩም የነበሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉና ሽማግሌዎቹ እንዲህ አሉ፦ «ምስክሮች [ነን]። ወደ ቤትህ የምትገባውን ሴት {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሁለቱ የእስራኤልን ቤት እንደ ሠሩት እንደ ራሔልና እንደ ልያ ያድርጋት፤ አንተም በኤፍራታ ብርታትን አድርግ፤ በቤተ ልሔምም ስምን ጥራ።
am.B: በበሩ የነበሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉና ሽማግሌዎቹም እንዲህ ብለው መለሱ፦ «ምስክሮች ነን። ወደ ቤትህ የምትገባውን ሴት {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የእስራኤልን ቤተሰብ እንደ ገነቡት እንደ ሁለቱ ሴቶች እንደ ራሔልና እንደ ልያ ያድርጋት። በኤፍራታ በብልጽግና ኑር፤ በቤተ ልሔምም ስምህ የታወቀ ይሁን።
am.R: በበሩ የነበሩ ሰዎች ሁሉና የከተማዋ ሽማግሌዎችም እንዲህ አሉ፦ «አዎ፣ አይተናል። ወደ ቤትህ የምትገባውን ሩትን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ራሔልና እንደ ልያ እንዲያደርጋት እንጸልያለን። እነዚያ ሁለት ሴቶች ለእስራኤል መላ ቤተሰቡን ሰጡት። በኤፍራታ በርትተህ ባለ ጠጋ ሁን፤ ስምህም በቤተ ልሔም የታወቀ ይሁን።

hi.L: और फाटक पर के सब लोगों ने और पुरनियों ने कहा, "[हम] गवाह [हैं]। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उस स्त्री को जो आपके घर में आ रही है, राहेल और लिआ के समान करें, जिन दोनों ने इस्राएल का घराना बनाया। और आप एप्रात में बल कमाएँ और बैतलहम में [अपना] नाम प्रसिद्ध करें।
hi.B: फाटक पर के सब लोगों और बुज़ुर्ग अगुवों ने उत्तर दिया, "हम गवाह हैं। जो स्त्री आपके घर में आ रही है, उसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} राहेल और लिआ के समान करें, जिन दोनों ने इस्राएल का घराना बसाया। आप एप्रात में फलें-फूलें और बैतलहम में आपका नाम प्रसिद्ध हो।
hi.R: तब फाटक पर के सब लोगों और नगर के बुज़ुर्ग अगुवों ने कहा, "हाँ, हमने देखा है। हमारी प्रार्थना है कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} रूत को, जो आपके घर में आ रही है, राहेल और लिआ के समान करें। उन दोनों स्त्रियों से इस्राएल का सारा परिवार बना। आप एप्रात में बलवान और धनी हों, और बैतलहम में आपका नाम प्रसिद्ध हो।

ru.L: И сказал весь народ, который у ворот, и старейшины: «[Мы] свидетели. Пусть сделает {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} женщину, входящую в твой дом, как Рахиль и как Лию, которые обе построили дом Израиля. И приобретай силу в Ефрафе и прославь имя в Вифлееме.
ru.B: Весь народ у ворот и старейшины ответили: «Мы свидетели. Пусть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сделает женщину, которая входит в твой дом, подобной Рахили и Лии, двум женщинам, которые построили семью Израиля. Процветай в Ефрафе и будь знаменит в Вифлееме.
ru.R: Тогда все люди у ворот и старейшины сказали: «Да, мы видели это. Мы молимся, чтобы {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сделал Руфь, которая входит в твой дом, такой же, как Рахиль и Лия. От этих двух женщин произошёл весь народ Израиля. Пусть ты станешь сильным и богатым в Ефрафе, и пусть твоё имя прославится в Вифлееме.

uk.L: І сказав увесь народ, який [був] у брамі, і старійшини: «Свідки. Нехай {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} зробить жінку, яка входить у твій дім, як Рахіль і як Лія, що обидві збудували дім Ізраїля. І чини силу в Ефраті і проголошуй імʼя у Вифлеємі.
uk.B: Увесь народ, що був біля брами, і старійшини відповіли: «Ми свідки. Нехай {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} зробить жінку, яка входить у твій дім, такою, як Рахіль і Лія, ті дві, що збудували родину Ізраїля. Нехай ти процвітаєш в Ефраті і нехай твоє імʼя буде славне у Вифлеємі.
uk.R: Тоді всі люди біля брами й міські старійшини сказали: «Так, ми це бачили. Ми молимося, щоб {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} зробив Рут, яка входить у твій дім, такою, як Рахіль і Лія. Ці дві жінки дали Ізраїлеві весь його рід. Нехай ти станеш сильним і багатим в Ефраті, і нехай твоє імʼя буде славне у Вифлеємі.

ja.L: すると門にいたすべての民と長老たちは言った。「[わたしたちは]証人です。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、あなたの家に入るその女を、二人でイスラエルの家を建てたラケルとレアのようにしてくださいますように。あなたがエフラタで力を得、ベツレヘムで名をあげますように。
ja.B: 門にいたすべての民と長老たちは答えた。「わたしたちが証人です。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、あなたの家に入るこの女性を、イスラエルの家を共に築いたラケルとレアのようにしてくださいますように。あなたがエフラタで栄え、ベツレヘムで名を高めますように。
ja.R: すると、門にいたすべての人々と町の指導者たちは言いました。「はい、わたしたちは見ました。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、あなたの家に入るルツを、ラケルとレアのようにしてくださるように祈ります。この二人の女性から、イスラエルの家族全体が生まれたのです。あなたがエフラタで力をつけ、豊かになりますように。そして、あなたの名がベツレヘムで有名になりますように。

id.L: Dan seluruh rakyat yang [ada] di pintu gerbang, dan tua-tua, berkata, "[Kami adalah] saksi. Kiranya {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} membuat perempuan yang masuk ke rumahmu itu seperti Rahel dan seperti Lea, yang keduanya membangun keturunan Israel. Dan kiranya engkau menjadi kuat di Efrata dan termasyhur namanya di Betlehem.
id.B: Seluruh rakyat di pintu gerbang dan tua-tua menjawab, "Kami menjadi saksi. Kiranya {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} membuat perempuan yang masuk ke rumahmu itu seperti Rahel dan Lea, dua perempuan yang membangun keluarga Israel. Kiranya engkau makmur di Efrata dan termasyhur di Betlehem.
id.R: Lalu semua orang di pintu gerbang dan para pemimpin kota berkata, "Ya, kami sudah melihatnya. Kami berdoa supaya {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} membuat Rut, yang masuk ke rumahmu, seperti Rahel dan Lea. Kedua perempuan itu memberi Israel seluruh keluarganya. Semoga kamu menjadi kuat dan kaya di Efrata, dan semoga namamu terkenal di Betlehem.

decisions.choice: like Rachel and like Leah, who built the house of Israel: the mothers of Jacob's sons
decisions.reason: Rachel and Leah, with their servants, bore the sons of Jacob, from whom the tribes of Israel came (Genesis 29:31-30:24; 35:16-18). "Build a house" means to give a man a family line, the very thing a husband's brother was to do for the dead (Deuteronomy 25:9). Rachel was buried on the way to Ephrath, that is, Bethlehem (Genesis 35:19), so her name fits a blessing spoken there. Rachel is named first though Leah was the elder, perhaps because she was Jacob's loved wife and was linked with Bethlehem.

decisions.choice: make strength: prosper, gain standing and family
decisions.reason: The word chayil means strength, ability, wealth and worth. It was used of Boaz (2:1) and of Ruth (3:11). Here it is a wish that Boaz will flourish, above all in the family the marriage will bring.

decisions.choice: proclaim a name in Bethlehem: be famous there
decisions.reason: To have one's name "called" or "proclaimed" is to be well known and remembered. The women say the same of the child (verse 14). The phrase may also look ahead to the naming of a son.

decisions.choice: Ephrathah and Bethlehem: two names for the same town and its clan
decisions.reason: Ephrathah was the old name of Bethlehem or of its clan (Genesis 35:19; Micah 5:1); Elimelech's family were "Ephrathites from Bethlehem" (1:2). The two names stand side by side as in Micah 5:1.

decisions.choice: Ruth
decisions.reason: Readable names the woman the people mean.

decisions.choice: Yes, we have seen it; We pray that
decisions.reason: Readable puts the one-word answer "Witnesses" and the wish form "may" in everyday words.

decisions.choice: "Rachel", "Léa"; "Éphrata"; "Pérès", "Tamar", "Juda" (verse 12)
decisions.reason: The names keep the forms already used in this translation: Rachel and Leah as in Genesis, Ephrathah as in Psalm 132:6, and Perez as in Genesis 38:29 and Matthew 1:3 ("Pérès").

decisions.choice: "Ra-chên", "Lê-a", "Ép-ra-ta"
decisions.reason: Rachel and Leah as the Genesis note; Ephrathah takes the same form as "người Ép-ra-ta" in 1:2.

decisions.choice: The people and elders answer Boaz in the 하오체
decisions.reason: They speak to a respected man of their own town as equals in a public blessing.

decisions.choice: conquiste valor (L); cresça em valor (B)
decisions.reason: Chayil (m2) is the word of 2:1 and 3:11, rendered there with "valor"; Literal and Balanced keep it, so the blessing on Boaz matches the words used of him and of Ruth. Readable says "forte e rico", as the English Readable does. "Efrata" is the form of Genesis 35:19 in Portuguese, beside "Belém" (m4).

decisions.choice: "राहेल", "लिआ" (as Genesis); "एप्रात" (Ephrathah, as Genesis 35:16-19)
decisions.reason: Names keep the forms of Genesis in this translation; Ephrathah is the same place and clan name as Genesis's Ephrath (m4), so it keeps "एप्रात". The people say "आप" to Boaz, a man of standing.

decisions.choice: Rachel "ラケル", Leah "レア" (GEN); Ephrathah "エフラタ" as Ephrath in GEN 35:16, 48:7
decisions.reason: Names in the forms Genesis settled.

decisions.choice: "Rahel", "Lea", "Efrata"; "kami", exclusive
decisions.reason: The glossary forms of the names. The townspeople speak of themselves as witnesses apart from Boaz, so "kami" is exclusive; they speak to Boaz as an equal ("engkau", L, B; "kamu", R).

en.B: Through the children {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gives you by this young woman, may your family be like the family of Perez, the son Tamar bore to Judah."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will give you children by this young woman. May they make your family like the family of Perez, the son Tamar had by Judah."

sw.B: Kupitia watoto ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupa kwa msichana huyu, jamaa yako na iwe kama jamaa ya Peresi, mwana ambaye Tamari alimzalia Yuda."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupa watoto kwa msichana huyu. Na wao waifanye jamaa yako kuwa kama jamaa ya Peresi, mwana ambaye Tamari alimzalia Yuda."

es.L: Y sea tu casa como la casa de Fares, al que Tamar dio a luz a Judá, por la descendencia que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dé de esta joven».
es.B: Que por los hijos que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dé de esta joven, tu familia llegue a ser como la familia de Fares, el hijo que Tamar le dio a Judá».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dará hijos de esta joven. Que ellos hagan tu familia como la familia de Fares, el hijo que Tamar tuvo con Judá».

fr.L: Et que ta maison soit comme la maison de Pérès, que Tamar enfanta à Juda, par la descendance que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te donnera de cette jeune femme. »
fr.B: Par les enfants que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te donnera de cette jeune femme, que ta famille soit comme la famille de Pérès, le fils que Tamar donna à Juda ! »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va te donner des enfants de cette jeune femme. Qu’ils rendent ta famille semblable à la famille de Pérès, le fils que Tamar a eu de Juda ! »

vi.L: Nguyện nhà ông được như nhà của Pha-rê, người mà Ta-ma đã sinh cho Giu-đa, nhờ dòng dõi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ ban cho ông bởi người thiếu phụ này."
vi.B: Nhờ những đứa con {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ ban cho ông bởi người thiếu phụ này, nguyện gia đình ông được như gia đình của Pha-rê, người con mà Ta-ma đã sinh cho Giu-đa."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ ban cho ông con cái bởi người thiếu phụ này. Nguyện con cái ấy làm cho gia đình ông được như gia đình của Pha-rê, người con mà Ta-ma đã sinh cho Giu-đa."

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 젊은 여자에게서 당신에게 주실 자손으로 말미암아, 당신의 집이 다말이 유다에게 낳아 준 베레스의 집과 같이 되기를 바라오."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 젊은 여자에게서 당신에게 주실 자녀들로 말미암아, 당신의 집안이 다말이 유다에게 낳아 준 베레스의 집안처럼 되기를 바라오."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 젊은 여자에게서 당신에게 자녀들을 주실 것이오. 그 자녀들 때문에 당신의 집안이, 다말이 유다에게서 낳은 아들 베레스의 집안처럼 되기를 바라오."

pt.L: E que a sua casa seja como a casa de Perez, que Tamar deu à luz a Judá, pela descendência que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe der desta moça."
pt.B: Que, pelos filhos que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe der por meio desta moça, a sua família seja como a família de Perez, o filho que Tamar deu a Judá."
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai lhe dar filhos por meio desta moça. Que eles tornem a sua família como a família de Perez, o filho que Tamar teve com Judá."

am.L: ከዚህችም ወጣት ሴት {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከሚሰጥህ ዘር፣ ቤትህ ትዕማር ለይሁዳ እንደ ወለደችለት እንደ ፋሬስ ቤት ይሁን።»
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከዚህች ወጣት ሴት በሚሰጥህ ልጆች፣ ቤተሰብህ ትዕማር ለይሁዳ እንደ ወለደችለት እንደ ፋሬስ ቤተሰብ ይሁን።»
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከዚህች ወጣት ሴት ልጆች ይሰጥሃል። እነርሱም ቤተሰብህን ትዕማር ከይሁዳ እንደ ወለደችው እንደ ፋሬስ ቤተሰብ ያድርጉት።»

hi.B: जो सन्तान {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} आपको इस युवती से देंगे, उसके द्वारा आपका परिवार फिरिस के परिवार के समान हो, जिसे तामार ने यहूदा के लिए जन्म दिया था।"
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} इस युवती से आपको सन्तान देंगे। वह सन्तान आपके परिवार को फिरिस के परिवार के समान बना दे, जो यहूदा और तामार का पुत्र था।"

ru.L: И пусть будет дом твой, как дом Фареса, которого родила Фамарь Иуде, от потомства, которое даст тебе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} от этой молодой женщины.»
ru.B: Пусть через детей, которых {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} даст тебе от этой молодой женщины, твоя семья станет как семья Фареса, сына, которого Фамарь родила Иуде.»
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} даст тебе детей от этой молодой женщины. Пусть благодаря им твоя семья станет как семья Фареса, сына, которого Фамарь родила от Иуды.»

uk.L: І нехай буде твій дім, як дім Фареса, якого Тамара народила Юді, від потомства, яке {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дасть тобі від цієї молодої жінки.»
uk.B: Через дітей, яких {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дасть тобі від цієї молодої жінки, нехай твоя родина стане, як родина Фареса, сина, якого Тамара народила Юді.»
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дасть тобі дітей від цієї молодої жінки. Нехай вони зроблять твою родину такою, як родина Фареса, сина, якого Тамара народила від Юди.»

ja.L: そして、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がこの若い女によってあなたに与えてくださる子孫によって、あなたの家が、タマルがユダに産んだペレツの家のようになりますように。」
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がこの若い女性によってあなたに与えてくださる子どもたちによって、あなたの家が、タマルがユダに産んだ息子ペレツの家のようになりますように。」
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、この若い女性によって、あなたに子どもを与えてくださるでしょう。その子どもたちによって、あなたの家が、ペレツの家のようになりますように。ペレツは、タマルがユダとの間に産んだ子です。」

id.L: Dan kiranya keturunanmu menjadi seperti keturunan Peres, yang dilahirkan Tamar bagi Yehuda, melalui anak-anak yang akan diberikan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} kepadamu dari perempuan muda ini."
id.B: Melalui anak-anak yang diberikan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} kepadamu dari perempuan muda ini, kiranya keluargamu menjadi seperti keluarga Peres, anak yang dilahirkan Tamar bagi Yehuda."
id.R: {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} akan memberi kamu anak-anak dari perempuan muda ini. Semoga mereka membuat keluargamu seperti keluarga Peres, anak Tamar dan Yehuda."

decisions.choice: the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah: an earlier widow who kept a dead man's line alive
decisions.reason: Tamar was left a childless widow, and Judah's family failed to give her a husband as custom required. She bore Perez and Zerah to Judah himself (Genesis 38). Like Ruth, she was a foreign woman who kept a family line from dying out. Perez's family became the leading clan of Judah, and Boaz belonged to it (verses 18-21; 1 Chronicles 2:4-5).

decisions.choice: this young woman: Ruth
decisions.reason: The word na'arah is used of a young woman not yet long married. Boaz had called Ruth a young woman when he first saw her (2:5), and he had spoken of the younger men she could have chosen (3:10).

decisions.choice: the offspring that the LORD will give you: children as the LORD's gift
decisions.reason: The people's blessing says that the child will come from the LORD, and the next verse says that he did (verse 13).

decisions.choice: the clause about children comes first
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the gift of children before the comparison so the long sentence reads clearly in English. Literal keeps the Hebrew order.

decisions.choice: "Pha-rê" and "Ta-ma"
decisions.reason: As the Genesis note, so that the reader can find the story of Genesis 38 that the meaning decision points to.

decisions.choice: "वह सन्तान ... बना दे" (singular)
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "May they make", meaning the children. In Hindi "वे" would read as the honorific for the LORD, so Readable keeps "सन्तान" as a collective singular. "फिरिस" and "तामार" are the forms of Matthew 1:3.

decisions.choice: "Фарес", "Тамара"; in 4:18-22 "Есром", "Арам", "Амінадав", "Наассон", "Салмон", "Єссей"
decisions.reason: The forms of Matthew 1:3-5 in this translation, so the line of David reads the same in both Testaments; the terms note's rule that New Testament forms win. Literal 4:20 keeps the written "Салма".

decisions.choice: Perez "ペレツ", Tamar "タマル", Judah "ユダ", as GEN 38 and MAT 1:3
decisions.reason: NT and Genesis forms.

decisions.choice: "Peres", "Tamar", "Yehuda"
decisions.reason: "Tamar" and "Yehuda" are the glossary forms; "Peres" is formed by the style guide's rules (the Hebrew "ts" written "s"), the form the Indonesian church knows. Added to the glossary.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֨ח בֹּ֤עַז אֶת־רוּת֙ וַתְּהִי־ל֣וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֖א אֵלֶ֑יהָ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֥ה לָ֛הּ הֵרָי֖וֹן וַתֵּ֥לֶד בֵּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Boaz Ruth, and she became to him for a wife, and he went in to her, and gave YHWH to her conception, and she bore a son.

en.L: So Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife. And he went in to her, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave her conception, and she bore a son.
en.B: So Boaz took Ruth home, and she became his wife. He slept with her, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} let her conceive, and she gave birth to a son.
en.R: So Boaz married Ruth, and she became his wife. They came together as husband and wife, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} made it possible for her to become pregnant. She gave birth to a son.

sw.L: Basi Boazi akamtwaa Ruthu, naye akawa mkewe. Naye akaingia kwake, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamjalia mimba, akazaa mwana.
sw.B: Basi Boazi alimchukua Ruthu nyumbani, naye akawa mke wake. Alilala naye, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamjalia kupata mimba, akazaa mwana.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Boazi alimwoa Ruthu, naye akawa mke wake. Walikutana kama mume na mke, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwezesha kupata mimba. Akazaa mtoto wa kiume.

es.L: Así que Booz tomó a Rut, y ella fue su mujer. Y él entró a ella, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le concedió concebir, y dio a luz un hijo.
es.B: Así que Booz tomó a Rut, y ella llegó a ser su esposa. Él se unió a ella, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo que concibiera, y dio a luz un hijo.
es.R: Así que Booz se casó con Rut, y ella llegó a ser su esposa. Se unieron como esposo y esposa, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo posible que ella quedara embarazada. Dio a luz un hijo.

fr.L: Et Booz prit Ruth, et elle devint sa femme. Et il entra auprès d’elle, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui donna de concevoir, et elle enfanta un fils.
fr.B: Booz prit donc Ruth chez lui, et elle devint sa femme. Il s’unit à elle, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui accorda de concevoir ; elle mit au monde un fils.
fr.R: Booz a donc épousé Ruth, et elle est devenue sa femme. Ils se sont unis comme mari et femme, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a permis à Ruth d’être enceinte. Elle a mis au monde un fils.

vi.L: Vậy Bô-ô lấy Ru-tơ, và nàng trở thành vợ ông. Ông ăn ở với nàng, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho nàng thụ thai, và nàng sinh một con trai.
vi.B: Vậy Bô-ô cưới Ru-tơ về, và nàng trở thành vợ ông. Ông ăn ở với nàng, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho nàng thụ thai, rồi nàng sinh một con trai.
vi.R: Vậy Bô-ô cưới Ru-tơ, và nàng trở thành vợ ông. Họ chung sống như vợ chồng, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho nàng có thai. Nàng sinh một con trai.

ko.L: 보아스가 룻을 맞아들여 룻이 그의 아내가 되었다. 그가 룻에게 들어가니, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 룻에게 임신하게 하셔서 룻이 아들을 낳았다.
ko.B: 이렇게 보아스는 룻을 집으로 맞아들였고, 룻은 그의 아내가 되었다. 보아스가 룻과 잠자리를 같이하니, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 룻이 임신하게 하셔서 룻이 아들을 낳았다.
ko.R: 이렇게 보아스는 룻과 결혼했고, 룻은 그의 아내가 되었다. 그들은 부부로 함께 살았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 룻이 아이를 가질 수 있게 해 주셨다. 룻은 아들을 낳았다.

pt.L: E Boaz tomou Rute, e ela se tornou sua mulher; e ele se deitou com ela, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe concedeu conceber, e ela deu à luz um filho.
pt.B: Assim Boaz levou Rute para casa, e ela se tornou sua mulher. Ele se deitou com ela, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} permitiu que ela engravidasse, e ela deu à luz um filho.
pt.R: Então Boaz se casou com Rute, e ela se tornou sua mulher. Eles viveram juntos como marido e mulher, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez com que ela ficasse grávida. Ela deu à luz um filho.

am.L: ቦዔዝም ሩትን ወሰዳት፤ ሚስትም ሆነችው፤ ወደ እርሷም ገባ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ፅንስን ሰጣት፤ ወንድ ልጅም ወለደች።
am.B: ስለዚህ ቦዔዝ ሩትን ወደ ቤቱ ወሰዳት፤ እርሷም ሚስቱ ሆነች። ከእርሷም ጋር ተኛ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም እንድትፀንስ አደረጋት፤ ወንድ ልጅም ወለደች።
am.R: ስለዚህ ቦዔዝ ሩትን አገባ፤ እርሷም ሚስቱ ሆነች። እንደ ባልና ሚስት አብረው ሆኑ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም እንድትፀንስ አስቻላት። እርሷም ወንድ ልጅ ወለደች።

hi.L: इस प्रकार बोअज़ ने रूत को लिया, और वह उसकी पत्नी हो गई। और वह उसके पास गया, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उसका गर्भ ठहराया, और उसने एक पुत्र को जन्म दिया।
hi.B: तो बोअज़ रूत को अपने घर ले आया, और वह उसकी पत्नी बन गई। वह उसके साथ सोया, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उसे गर्भवती होने दिया, और उसने एक पुत्र को जन्म दिया।
hi.R: इस तरह बोअज़ ने रूत से विवाह किया, और वह उसकी पत्नी बन गई। वे पति-पत्नी के रूप में एक हुए, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने ऐसा किया कि वह गर्भवती हो गई। उसने एक बेटे को जन्म दिया।

ru.L: И взял Вооз Руфь, и она стала ему женой, и он вошёл к ней, и {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал ей зачатие, и она родила сына.
ru.B: Так Вооз взял Руфь в свой дом, и она стала его женой. Он лёг с ней, и {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал ей зачать, и она родила сына.
ru.R: Так Вооз женился на Руфи, и она стала его женой. Они стали жить как муж и жена, и {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сделал так, что она забеременела. Она родила сына.

uk.L: І взяв Вооз Рут, і стала вона йому за жінку, і він увійшов до неї, і {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав їй завагітніти, і вона народила сина.
uk.B: Тож Вооз узяв Рут додому, і вона стала його жінкою. Він ліг із нею, і {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав їй завагітніти, і вона народила сина.
uk.R: Тож Вооз одружився з Рут, і вона стала його жінкою. Вони зійшлися як чоловік і жінка, і {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} зробив так, що вона завагітніла. Вона народила сина.

ja.L: こうしてボアズはルツを迎え、彼女は彼の妻となった。そして彼は彼女のところに入り、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は彼女に身ごもることを与えられ、彼女は男の子を産んだ。
ja.B: こうしてボアズはルツを家に迎え、ルツはボアズの妻となった。ボアズがルツと床を共にすると、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はルツを身ごもらせてくださり、ルツは男の子を産んだ。
ja.R: こうしてボアズはルツと結婚し、ルツはボアズの妻になりました。二人は夫婦として結ばれました。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がルツに子どもを授けてくださったので、ルツは身ごもり、男の子を産みました。

id.L: Demikianlah Boas mengambil Rut, dan dia menjadi istrinya. Dan dia menghampirinya, dan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} membuat dia mengandung, dan dia melahirkan seorang anak laki-laki.
id.B: Demikianlah Boas membawa Rut ke rumahnya, dan Rut menjadi istrinya. Boas bersetubuh dengan dia, dan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} membuat dia mengandung, lalu dia melahirkan seorang anak laki-laki.
id.R: Demikianlah Boas menikah dengan Rut, dan Rut menjadi istrinya. Mereka hidup bersama sebagai suami istri, dan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} memungkinkan Rut hamil. Dia melahirkan seorang anak laki-laki.

decisions.choice: the LORD gave her conception: the child is the LORD's doing
decisions.reason: Ruth had been married to Mahlon for about ten years with no child (1:4-5). The narrator seldom says that the LORD acts directly; here and in 1:6, when he gave his people food, he does. The people's prayer in verse 12 is answered at once.

decisions.choice: he went in to her: he had sexual relations with her
decisions.reason: This is the usual way of speaking of a man consummating a marriage (Genesis 29:23; 38:2).

decisions.choice: slept with her / came together as husband and wife
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly what the idiom means (m2); Literal keeps "went in to her".

decisions.choice: se deitou com ela
decisions.reason: Portuguese cannot keep "went in to her" without sounding odd or crude, so Literal says "se deitou com ela", as Genesis 29:23 and 38:2 have it in Portuguese; the meaning note gives the Hebrew idiom (m2).

decisions.choice: "he went in to her" "彼女のところに入り" (L), "床を共にすると" (B), "夫婦として結ばれました" (R)
decisions.reason: A modest idiom at every level, as the English.

source.text: וַתֹּאמַ֤רְנָה הַנָּשִׁים֙ אֶֽל־נָעֳמִ֔י בָּר֣וּךְ יְהוָ֔ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֣א הִשְׁבִּ֥ית לָ֛ךְ גֹּאֵ֖ל הַיּ֑וֹם וְיִקָּרֵ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And said the women to Naomi, blessed [be] YHWH, who not has caused to cease for you [a] redeemer today; and may be proclaimed his name in Israel.

en.L: And the women said to Naomi, "Blessed [be] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who has not left you without a redeemer today. And may his name be proclaimed in Israel.
en.B: The women said to Naomi, "Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who has not left you this day without a family redeemer! May his name be renowned in Israel.
en.R: The women of the town said to Naomi, "Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Today {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given you a family redeemer, so that you are not left without one. May this child become famous in Israel.

sw.L: Nao wanawake wakamwambia Naomi, "Abarikiwe {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambaye hakukuacha leo bila mkombozi. Na jina lake litangazwe katika Israeli.
sw.B: Wanawake walimwambia Naomi, "Asifiwe {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambaye leo hajakuacha bila mkombozi wa jamaa! Jina lake na liwe maarufu katika Israeli.
sw.R: Wanawake wa mji walimwambia Naomi, "Asifiwe {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Leo amekupa mkombozi wa jamaa, ili usibaki bila mmoja. Mtoto huyu na awe maarufu katika Israeli.

es.L: Y las mujeres dijeron a Noemí: «Bendito [sea] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que no te ha dejado hoy sin redentor. Y que su nombre sea proclamado en Israel.
es.B: Las mujeres le dijeron a Noemí: «¡Alabado sea {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que no te ha dejado hoy sin pariente redentor! Que su nombre sea famoso en Israel.
es.R: Las mujeres del pueblo le dijeron a Noemí: «¡Alabado sea {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! Hoy {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te ha dado un pariente redentor, para que no te quedes sin uno. Que este niño llegue a ser famoso en Israel.

fr.L: Et les femmes dirent à Noémi : « Béni [soit] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui ne t’a pas laissée aujourd’hui sans rédempteur. Et que son nom soit proclamé en Israël !
fr.B: Les femmes dirent à Noémi : « Loué soit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui ne t’a pas laissée aujourd’hui sans proche parent rédempteur ! Que le nom de cet enfant soit célèbre en Israël !
fr.R: Les femmes de la ville ont dit à Noémi : « Loué soit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Aujourd’hui, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a donné un proche parent rédempteur ; tu n’es pas restée sans personne. Que cet enfant devienne célèbre en Israël !

vi.L: Các phụ nữ nói với Na-ô-mi: "Chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng hôm nay đã không để bà thiếu người chuộc lại. Nguyện danh người ấy được truyền tụng trong Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Các phụ nữ nói với Na-ô-mi: "Ngợi khen {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng hôm nay đã không để bà thiếu người bà con có quyền chuộc lại! Nguyện danh đứa trẻ được lừng lẫy trong Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Các phụ nữ trong thành nói với Na-ô-mi: "Ngợi khen {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Hôm nay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho bà một người bà con có quyền chuộc lại, để bà không thiếu người ấy. Nguyện đứa trẻ này được nổi danh trong Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 여자들이 나오미에게 말했다. "오늘 당신에게 기업 무를 자가 끊어지지 않게 하신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양합니다. 그의 이름이 이스라엘에서 널리 불리기를 바랍니다.
ko.B: 여자들이 나오미에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양합니다! 그분께서 오늘 당신에게 집안을 책임질 친족이 없지 않게 하셨습니다. 이 아이의 이름이 이스라엘에서 널리 알려지기를 바랍니다.
ko.R: 성의 여자들이 나오미에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양합니다! 오늘 그분께서 당신에게 집안을 책임질 친족을 주셔서, 당신이 홀로 남지 않게 하셨습니다. 이 아이가 이스라엘에서 유명해지기를 바랍니다.

pt.L: E as mulheres disseram a Noemi: "Bendito [seja] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que hoje não deixou você sem resgatador! E que o nome dele seja proclamado em Israel.
pt.B: As mulheres disseram a Noemi: "Louvado seja {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que hoje não deixou você sem um resgatador da família! Que o nome dele seja famoso em Israel.
pt.R: As mulheres da cidade disseram a Noemi: "Louvado seja {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}! Hoje {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deu a você um resgatador da família, para que você não fique sem nenhum. Que este menino se torne famoso em Israel.

am.L: ሴቶቹም ኑኃሚንን አሏት፦ «ዛሬ ያለ ቤዢ ያልተወሽ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የተባረከ ይሁን፤ ስሙም በእስራኤል የተጠራ ይሁን።
am.B: ሴቶቹም ኑኃሚንን እንዲህ አሏት፦ «በዚህ ቀን ያለ ቤዢ ዘመድ ያልተወሽ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይመስገን! ስሙም በእስራኤል የታወቀ ይሁን።
am.R: የከተማዋ ሴቶችም ኑኃሚንን እንዲህ አሏት፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይመስገን! ያለ ቤዢ ዘመድ እንዳትቀሪ ዛሬ ቤዢ ዘመድ ሰጥቶሻል። ይህ ሕፃን በእስራኤል የታወቀ ይሁን።

hi.L: और स्त्रियों ने नाओमी से कहा, "धन्य [हों] {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, जिन्होंने आज तुम्हें छुड़ानेवाले के बिना नहीं छोड़ा। और उसका नाम इस्राएल में प्रसिद्ध हो।
hi.B: स्त्रियों ने नाओमी से कहा, "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति हो, जिन्होंने आज के दिन तुम्हें परिवार के छुड़ानेवाले के बिना नहीं छोड़ा! इस्राएल में उसका नाम प्रसिद्ध हो।
hi.R: नगर की स्त्रियों ने नाओमी से कहा, "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति हो! आज उन्होंने तुम्हें परिवार का एक छुड़ानेवाला दिया है, ताकि तुम उसके बिना न रहो। यह बच्चा इस्राएल में प्रसिद्ध हो।

ru.L: И сказали женщины Ноемини: «Благословен {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, который не оставил тебя сегодня без выкупщика! И пусть будет прославлено имя его в Израиле.
ru.B: Женщины сказали Ноемини: «Хвала {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, который не оставил тебя сегодня без выкупщика семьи! Пусть его имя будет славно в Израиле.
ru.R: Женщины города сказали Ноемини: «Хвала {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}! Сегодня {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} дал тебе выкупщика семьи, чтобы ты не осталась без него. Пусть этот ребёнок прославится в Израиле.

uk.L: І сказали жінки до Ноомі: «Благословенний {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, який не залишив тебе сьогодні без викупителя! І нехай проголошується його імʼя в Ізраїлі.
uk.B: Жінки сказали Ноомі: «Хвала {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, який не залишив тебе сьогодні без родича-викупителя! Нехай його імʼя буде славне в Ізраїлі.
uk.R: Жінки міста сказали Ноомі: «Хвала {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}! Сьогодні {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дав тобі родича-викупителя, щоб ти не залишилася без нього. Нехай ця дитина стане славною в Ізраїлі.

ja.L: そして女たちはナオミに言った。「今日、あなたに買い戻す者を絶やさなかった{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ほめたたえられよ。その名がイスラエルで呼ばれますように。
ja.B: 女たちはナオミに言った。「今日、あなたに買い戻しの責任のある親族を欠けさせなかった{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、ほめたたえられるように。その名がイスラエルで高められますように。
ja.R: 町の女の人たちはナオミに言いました。「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよう。今日、あなたに買い戻す責任のある親類を与えてくださった。もう、あなたにその人がいないということはない。この子がイスラエルで有名になりますように。

id.L: Dan perempuan-perempuan itu berkata kepada Naomi, "Terpujilah {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, yang tidak membiarkan engkau tanpa penebus pada hari ini. Dan kiranya namanya termasyhur di Israel.
id.B: Para perempuan berkata kepada Naomi, "Pujilah {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, yang pada hari ini tidak membiarkan engkau tanpa kerabat penebus! Kiranya namanya termasyhur di Israel.
id.R: Para perempuan di kota itu berkata kepada Naomi, "Pujilah {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}! Hari ini {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} telah memberimu seorang kerabat penebus, sehingga engkau tidak dibiarkan tanpa penebus. Semoga anak ini menjadi terkenal di Israel.

decisions.choice: a redeemer, and his name: the newborn child
decisions.reason: The women mean the child. He is the one who will keep the family's name and land and care for Naomi when she is old (verse 15). Some take "his name" to mean the LORD's name, but the next verse goes on speaking of the child, and verse 11 used the same wish of Boaz.

decisions.choice: the women to Naomi: the end answers the beginning
decisions.reason: The women of Bethlehem who asked "Is this Naomi?" when she came home empty and bitter (1:19-21) now bless the LORD with her. The story that began with the loss of her husband and sons ends with a son for her family.

decisions.choice: blessed be the LORD: praise and thanks to God
decisions.reason: When a person "blesses" God, it means to praise and thank him for what he has done, as in Genesis 24:27.

decisions.choice: Praise the LORD
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "Praise" for "blessed be" when the one blessed is God (m3).

decisions.choice: this child
decisions.reason: Readable names the child as the one meant (m1), a choice the decision marks uncertain.

decisions.choice: "le nom de cet enfant" (B); "son nom" (L)
alternatives: "son nom" at Balanced, as the English "his name"
decisions.reason: In French "son nom" right after "le SEIGNEUR" would be read as the LORD's name; the meaning decision says the women mean the newborn child (m1). Balanced names the child, as the English Readable does; Literal keeps the bare pronoun.

decisions.choice: The women call Naomi "bà"
decisions.reason: Now that she is a grandmother with an heir, the women of the town honour her as an older woman; in 1:21 she called them "các chị".

decisions.choice: The women speak to Naomi in the formal polite style (합쇼체)
decisions.reason: As in 1:19-21, where Naomi spoke to them in the same style; the neighbours honour an older woman of the town.

decisions.choice: Louvado seja
decisions.reason: "Louvado seja" is how Brazilians praise God, the sense of m3, where the English Balanced and Readable say "Praise"; Literal keeps "Bendito", the same word as the blessings on people in 2:19-20.

decisions.choice: plain "उसका नाम" (his name)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "his name" as the newborn redeemer's (m1). Hindi uses honorific forms for God ("जिन्होंने") and plain ones for the child, so "उसका" points to the redeemer at Literal and Balanced without naming him; Readable says "यह बच्चा", as the English does. The women say "तुम" to Naomi, as she did to them in 1:20-21.

decisions.choice: "имя его" with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: "His name" is the child's (m1), not God's, so it takes no span; Readable's "он|Он" is the LORD, as the English span is.

decisions.choice: "Blessed be the LORD" "ほめたたえられよ" (L), "ほめたたえられるように" (B), "ほめたたえよう" (R), as GEN-consistency; the redeemer here is the newborn child
decisions.reason: The settled form of the blessing; go'el keeps the book's word at each level.

decisions.choice: Readable leaves the subject of "与えてくださった" unexpressed, since the English Readable has a pronoun (he) there, not the divine name
decisions.reason: Keeps one divine_name span, as the English Readable has.

decisions.choice: the women speak to Naomi as "engkau" at every level
decisions.reason: Neighbours who are her equals in age and standing; Readable keeps "engkau" rather than "kamu" for an older woman.

records.literal_gloss: And he will be to you for a restorer of life and to sustain your old age, for your daughter-in-law who loves you has borne him, who she [is] better to you than seven sons.

en.L: And he will be to you a restorer of life and a sustainer of your old age; for your daughter-in-law who loves you has borne him, she who [is] better to you than seven sons."
en.B: He will renew your life and take care of you when you are old. For your daughter-in-law, who loves you and means more to you than seven sons, is the one who has given birth to him."
en.R: This child will give you new life and look after you when you grow old. His mother is your daughter-in-law, who loves you. She is better to you than seven sons!"

sw.L: Naye atakuwa kwako mrejeshaji wa uhai na mtegemezaji wa uzee wako; kwa maana mkweo anayekupenda amemzaa, yeye aliye bora kwako kuliko wana saba."
sw.B: Atakuhuisha na kukutunza utakapokuwa mzee. Kwa maana mkweo, anayekupenda na aliye wa thamani kwako kuliko wana saba, ndiye aliyemzaa."
sw.R: Mtoto huyu atakupa uhai mpya na kukutunza utakapozeeka. Mama yake ni mkweo, anayekupenda. Yeye ni bora kwako kuliko wana saba!"

es.L: Y él será para ti restaurador de la vida y sustento de tu vejez; porque tu nuera, que te ama, lo ha dado a luz, la que es para ti mejor que siete hijos».
es.B: Él renovará tu vida y te sostendrá en tu vejez. Porque tu nuera, que te ama y que vale para ti más que siete hijos, es quien lo ha dado a luz».
es.R: Este niño te dará vida nueva y te cuidará cuando seas anciana. Su madre es tu nuera, que te ama. ¡Ella es para ti mejor que siete hijos!».

fr.B: Il te redonnera vie et prendra soin de toi dans ta vieillesse. Car c’est ta belle-fille qui l’a mis au monde, elle qui t’aime et qui vaut mieux pour toi que sept fils. »
fr.R: Cet enfant va te donner une nouvelle vie et il s’occupera de toi quand tu seras vieille. Sa mère, c’est ta belle-fille, qui t’aime. Elle vaut mieux pour toi que sept fils ! »

vi.L: Nó sẽ là người phục hồi sự sống cho bà và là người nuôi dưỡng bà lúc tuổi già; vì con dâu bà, người yêu thương bà, đã sinh ra nó, là người đối với bà còn quý hơn bảy con trai."
vi.B: Đứa trẻ sẽ làm cho đời bà tươi mới lại và chăm sóc bà lúc tuổi già. Vì chính con dâu bà, người yêu thương bà và đối với bà còn quý hơn bảy con trai, đã sinh ra nó."

ko.L: 그가 당신의 생명을 회복시키는 자요 당신의 노년을 돌보는 자가 될 것입니다. 당신을 사랑하는 며느리, 일곱 아들보다 당신에게 더 나은 그 며느리가 그를 낳았기 때문입니다."

ko.R: 이 아이가 당신에게 새로운 삶을 줄 것이고, 당신이 늙었을 때 당신을 돌볼 것입니다. 이 아이의 어머니는 당신을 사랑하는 며느리입니다. 그 며느리는 당신에게 일곱 아들보다 더 귀합니다!"

pt.L: E ele será para você aquele que faz voltar a vida e sustenta a sua velhice, pois a sua nora, que a ama, o deu à luz, ela que é melhor para você do que sete filhos."
pt.B: Ele vai renovar a sua vida e cuidar de você na velhice. Pois quem o deu à luz foi a sua nora, que ama você e que vale mais para você do que sete filhos."

am.L: እርሱም ሕይወትን የሚመልስልሽ፣ እርጅናሽንም የሚደግፍ ይሆንልሻል፤ የምትወድሽ፣ ከሰባት ወንዶች ልጆችም ይልቅ ለአንቺ የምትሻል ምራትሽ ወልዳዋለችና።»
am.B: እርሱ ሕይወትሽን ያድሳል፤ በእርጅናሽም ይጦርሻል። የምትወድሽና ከሰባት ወንዶች ልጆች ይልቅ ለአንቺ የምትበልጥ ምራትሽ ወልዳዋለችና።»

hi.R: यह बच्चा तुम्हें नया जीवन देगा और बुढ़ापे में तुम्हारी देखभाल करेगा। इसकी माँ तुम्हारी बहू है, जो तुमसे प्रेम करती है। वह तुम्हारे लिए सात बेटों से भी बढ़कर है!"

ru.B: Он обновит твою жизнь и позаботится о тебе в старости. Ведь его родила твоя невестка, которая любит тебя и которая для тебя дороже семи сыновей.»

ja.L: その子は、あなたの魂を生き返らせる者、あなたの老後を養う者となる。あなたを愛するあなたの嫁、あなたにとって七人の息子にもまさるあの嫁が、その子を産んだのだから。」

id.L: Dan dia akan menjadi pemulih hidupmu dan pemelihara masa tuamu; sebab menantumu yang mengasihi engkau telah melahirkannya, dia yang [lebih] baik bagimu daripada tujuh anak laki-laki."
id.B: Dia akan memberimu hidup yang baru dan memelihara engkau pada masa tuamu. Sebab menantumu, yang mengasihi engkau dan lebih berharga bagimu daripada tujuh anak laki-laki, dialah yang telah melahirkannya."

decisions.choice: a restorer of life: the answer to 1:21
decisions.reason: The words mean one who brings back a person's life or strength (Lamentations 1:16). Naomi had said that the LORD "brought me back empty" (1:21), using the same verb "bring back". Now the LORD has brought her life back.

decisions.choice: sustain your old age: provide for you when you are old
decisions.reason: The verb means to feed and support, as Joseph provided for his father's household (Genesis 47:12). An old widow without children had no one to depend on.

decisions.choice: better than seven sons: worth more than the fullest family
decisions.reason: Seven stands for completeness, and seven sons was a picture of perfect blessing for a mother (1 Samuel 2:5; compare 1 Samuel 1:8). Sons counted for much in that world; the women say Ruth's love is worth more than any number of them.

decisions.choice: His mother is your daughter-in-law
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long clause into short sentences and turns "has borne him" into "his mother".

decisions.choice: aquele que faz voltar a vida
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses the verb "bring back" of Naomi's complaint in 1:21 (m1), which Literal rendered there "me fez voltar vazia"; "faz voltar a vida" keeps the echo, which "restaurador" would hide. Balanced and Readable say "renovar" and "vida nova", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "जीवन लौटानेवाला" (restorer of life)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is "one who brings back life", using the verb "return" that runs through the book; "लौटाना" keeps the link with Naomi's "लौटा लाए हैं" (1:21), which the meaning decision notes (m1).

decisions.choice: meshiv nefesh "魂を生き返らせる者" (L), "生きる力を取り戻させ" (B), "新しい命を与え" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one of Naomi's "brought me back" (1:21); Japanese cannot repeat the root, so the decision records the echo.

es.B: Entonces Noemí tomó al niño, lo puso en su regazo y lo cuidó.
es.R: Noemí tomó al niño y lo apretó en sus brazos. Ella lo cuidaba.

fr.B: Noémi prit alors l’enfant, le posa sur ses genoux et prit soin de lui.
fr.R: Noémi a pris le bébé et l’a serré dans ses bras. Elle s’est occupée de lui.

vi.L: Na-ô-mi bồng đứa trẻ, đặt nó vào lòng mình, và trở thành người vú nuôi của nó.
vi.B: Na-ô-mi bồng đứa trẻ, đặt nó vào lòng mình, và chăm nom nó.
vi.R: Na-ô-mi bồng đứa bé trai và ôm chặt nó vào lòng. Bà chăm sóc nó.

ko.L: 나오미가 그 아이를 받아 품에 안고, 그의 양육자가 되었다.
ko.B: 나오미는 그 아이를 받아 무릎에 앉히고 그를 길렀다.
ko.R: 나오미는 그 아기를 받아 품에 꼭 안았다. 나오미는 그 아기를 돌보았다.

pt.L: E Noemi tomou o menino, e o pôs no seu colo, e se tornou a sua ama.
pt.B: Então Noemi pegou o menino, o pôs no colo e cuidou dele.
pt.R: Noemi pegou o bebê e o segurou bem junto de si, nos braços. Ela cuidou dele.

am.L: ኑኃሚንም ሕፃኑን ወስዳ በእቅፏ አኖረችው፤ ሞግዚትም ሆነችው።

am.R: ኑኃሚን ሕፃኑን ወስዳ በእቅፏ አጥብቃ ያዘችው። ትንከባከበውም ነበር።

hi.B: तब नाओमी ने उस बच्चे को लेकर अपनी गोद में रखा, और उसका पालन-पोषण किया।

ru.B: Тогда Ноеминь взяла ребёнка, положила его к себе на колени и заботилась о нём.
ru.R: Ноеминь взяла малыша и крепко прижала его к себе. Она заботилась о нём.

uk.L: І взяла Ноомі дитину, і поклала її собі на лоно, і стала їй нянькою.
uk.B: Тоді Ноомі взяла дитину, поклала собі на коліна і доглядала її.
uk.R: Ноомі взяла хлопчика і міцно пригорнула до себе. Вона доглядала його.

ja.L: そしてナオミはその子を取って、自分のふところに置き、その養い手となった。
ja.B: ナオミはその子を受け取って膝に抱き、世話をした。
ja.R: ナオミは男の赤ちゃんを抱き上げて、しっかりと胸に抱きました。そして、その子の世話をしました。

id.B: Lalu Naomi mengambil anak itu, meletakkannya di pangkuannya, dan mengasuhnya.
id.R: Naomi menggendong bayi laki-laki itu dan mendekapnya erat-erat. Dia mengasuhnya.

decisions.choice: nurse: one who looks after and brings up a child
decisions.reason: The word is not the usual word for a nursing mother. It is used of a man or woman who carries and cares for a child (Numbers 11:12; 2 Samuel 4:4; 2 Kings 10:1, 5). Naomi becomes the child's guardian.

decisions.choice: laid him in her bosom: holding him close as her own
decisions.reason: To hold a child to one's bosom shows love and care (2 Samuel 12:3; Numbers 11:12). Some see in the act a formal adoption of the child into Elimelech's family, but the text describes only the gesture.

decisions.choice: lap / arms; cared for him / took care of him
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use everyday words for "bosom" and say what "became his nurse" means (m1).

decisions.choice: "पालनेवाली" (one who brings up a child)
decisions.reason: "धाय" in Hindi means a wet nurse; the Hebrew word means one who looks after and brings up a child (m1), which "पालनेवाली" says.

source.text: וַתִּקְרֶאנָה֩ ל֨וֹ הַשְּׁכֵנ֥וֹת שֵׁם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יֻלַּד־בֵּ֖ן לְנָעֳמִ֑י וַתִּקְרֶ֤אנָֽה שְׁמוֹ֙ עוֹבֵ֔ד ה֥וּא אֲבִי־יִשַׁ֖י אֲבִ֥י דָוִֽד׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And called to him the neighbor women [a] name, saying, has been born [a] son to Naomi; and they called his name Obed; he [was the] father of Jesse, [the] father of David.

en.L: And the neighbor women gave him a name, saying, "A son has been born to Naomi." And they called his name Obed. He [was] the father of Jesse, the father of David.
en.B: The women who lived nearby gave him a name. "Naomi has a son!" they said, and they called him Obed. He became the father of Jesse, David's father.
en.R: The women who lived near Naomi named the boy. They said, "Naomi has a son!" They named him Obed. Obed grew up to be the father of Jesse, and Jesse was the father of King David.

sw.L: Nao wanawake jirani wakampa jina, wakisema, "Mwana amezaliwa kwa Naomi." Wakamwita jina lake Obedi. Yeye [alikuwa] baba wa Yese, baba wa Daudi.
sw.B: Wanawake walioishi jirani walimpa jina. Walisema, "Naomi amepata mwana!" Wakamwita Obedi. Yeye akawa baba wa Yese, baba wa Daudi.
sw.R: Wanawake walioishi karibu na Naomi walimpa mtoto jina. Walisema, "Naomi amepata mwana!" Wakamwita Obedi. Obedi alipokua alikuwa baba wa Yese, na Yese alikuwa baba wa Mfalme Daudi.

es.L: Y las vecinas le dieron un nombre, diciendo: «Le ha nacido un hijo a Noemí». Y llamaron su nombre Obed. Él [fue] el padre de Isaí, el padre de David.
es.B: Las vecinas le pusieron nombre. «¡Noemí tiene un hijo!», decían, y lo llamaron Obed. Él fue el padre de Isaí, el padre de David.
es.R: Las mujeres que vivían cerca de Noemí le pusieron nombre al niño. Decían: «¡Noemí tiene un hijo!». Lo llamaron Obed. Obed llegó a ser el padre de Isaí, e Isaí fue el padre del rey David.

fr.L: Et les voisines lui donnèrent un nom, en disant : « Un fils est né à Noémi. » Et elles appelèrent son nom Obed. Il [fut] le père de Jessé, le père de David.
fr.B: Les voisines lui donnèrent un nom. « Un fils est né à Noémi ! » disaient-elles, et elles l’appelèrent Obed. Il devint le père de Jessé, le père de David.
fr.R: Les femmes qui habitaient près de chez Noémi ont donné un nom au garçon. Elles ont dit : « Noémi a un fils ! » Elles l’ont appelé Obed. Quand Obed a grandi, il est devenu le père de Jessé, et Jessé a été le père du roi David.

vi.L: Các phụ nữ láng giềng đặt tên cho nó mà nói: "Một con trai đã sinh ra cho Na-ô-mi." Họ gọi tên nó là Ô-bết. Ông là cha của Gie-sê, cha của Đa-vít.
vi.B: Các phụ nữ hàng xóm đặt tên cho đứa trẻ. Họ nói: "Na-ô-mi có con trai rồi!" và họ gọi nó là Ô-bết. Ông là cha của Gie-sê, cha của Đa-vít.
vi.R: Các phụ nữ sống gần Na-ô-mi đặt tên cho đứa bé. Họ nói: "Na-ô-mi có con trai rồi!" Họ đặt tên nó là Ô-bết. Lớn lên, Ô-bết là cha của Gie-sê, và Gie-sê là cha của vua Đa-vít.

ko.L: 이웃 여자들이 "나오미에게 아들이 태어났다" 하며 그에게 이름을 지어 주었다. 그들은 그의 이름을 오벳이라고 불렀다. 그는 다윗의 아버지 이새의 아버지였다.
ko.B: 이웃 여자들이 그 아이에게 이름을 지어 주었다. 그들은 "나오미에게 아들이 생겼다!" 하고 말하며, 아이의 이름을 오벳이라고 했다. 그가 바로 다윗의 아버지 이새의 아버지이다.
ko.R: 나오미의 이웃 여자들이 그 아이의 이름을 지어 주었다. 그들은 "나오미에게 아들이 생겼다!" 하고 말했다. 그들은 아이의 이름을 오벳이라고 지었다. 오벳은 자라서 이새의 아버지가 되었고, 이새는 다윗 왕의 아버지였다.

pt.L: E as vizinhas lhe deram um nome, dizendo: "Nasceu um filho a Noemi." E chamaram o seu nome Obede. Ele [foi] o pai de Jessé, o pai de Davi.
pt.B: As vizinhas lhe deram um nome. "Noemi tem um filho!", elas diziam, e o chamaram de Obede. Ele foi o pai de Jessé, pai de Davi.
pt.R: As mulheres que moravam perto de Noemi deram nome ao menino. Elas disseram: "Noemi tem um filho!" E o chamaram de Obede. Obede cresceu e foi o pai de Jessé, e Jessé foi o pai do rei Davi.

am.L: ጎረቤቶቹም ሴቶች፦ «ለኑኃሚን ወንድ ልጅ ተወለደላት» ብለው ስም አወጡለት፤ ስሙንም ኢዮቤድ ብለው ጠሩት። እርሱም የዳዊት አባት የእሴይ አባት [ነው]።
am.B: በአጠገቧ የሚኖሩ ሴቶች ስም አወጡለት። «ኑኃሚን ወንድ ልጅ አገኘች!» አሉ፤ ኢዮቤድም ብለው ጠሩት። እርሱም የዳዊት አባት የሆነው የእሴይ አባት ሆነ።
am.R: በኑኃሚን አጠገብ የሚኖሩ ሴቶች ለሕፃኑ ስም አወጡለት። «ኑኃሚን ወንድ ልጅ አገኘች!» አሉ። ስሙንም ኢዮቤድ አሉት። ኢዮቤድ አድጎ የእሴይ አባት ሆነ፤ እሴይም የንጉሥ ዳዊት አባት ነበረ።

hi.L: और पड़ोसिनों ने उसका नाम रखा, यह कहकर, "नाओमी के लिए एक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ है।" और उन्होंने उसका नाम ओबेद रखा। वह यिशै का पिता [था], जो दाऊद का पिता [था]।
hi.B: पास-पड़ोस की स्त्रियों ने उसका नाम रखा। "नाओमी के एक पुत्र हुआ है!" उन्होंने कहा, और उन्होंने उसका नाम ओबेद रखा। वह यिशै का पिता हुआ, जो दाऊद का पिता था।
hi.R: नाओमी के पास रहनेवाली स्त्रियों ने लड़के का नाम रखा। उन्होंने कहा, "नाओमी के एक बेटा हुआ है!" उन्होंने उसका नाम ओबेद रखा। ओबेद बड़ा होकर यिशै का पिता बना, और यिशै राजा दाऊद का पिता था।

ru.L: И дали ему соседки имя, говоря: «Родился сын у Ноемини.» И назвали его имя Овид. Он — отец Иессея, отца Давида.
ru.B: Соседки дали ему имя. «У Ноемини родился сын!» — сказали они и назвали его Овидом. Он стал отцом Иессея, отца Давида.
ru.R: Женщины, которые жили рядом с Ноеминью, дали мальчику имя. Они сказали: «У Ноемини есть сын!» Они назвали его Овид. Когда Овид вырос, он стал отцом Иессея, а Иессей был отцом царя Давида.

uk.L: І дали йому сусідки імʼя, кажучи: «Народився син у Ноомі.» І назвали вони його імʼя Овид. Він батько Єссея, батька Давида.
uk.B: Жінки, що жили поруч, дали йому імʼя. «У Ноомі народився син!» — казали вони і назвали його Овид. Він став батьком Єссея, батька Давида.
uk.R: Жінки, які жили поруч із Ноомі, дали хлопчикові імʼя. Вони сказали: «У Ноомі є син!» Вони назвали його Овид. Овид виріс і став батьком Єссея, а Єссей був батьком царя Давида.

ja.L: そして近所の女たちは、「ナオミに男の子が生まれた」と言って、その子に名をつけた。そして彼女たちはその名をオベドと呼んだ。彼はダビデの父エッサイの父であった。
ja.B: 近所の女たちはその子に名をつけた。「ナオミに男の子が生まれた」と言って、その子をオベドと名づけた。オベドは、ダビデの父エッサイの父となった。
ja.R: ナオミの近所に住む女の人たちが、その子に名前をつけました。女の人たちは「ナオミに男の子が生まれた」と言いました。そして、その子をオベドと名づけました。オベドは大きくなって、エッサイの父親になりました。エッサイは、ダビデ王の父親です。

id.L: Dan perempuan-perempuan tetangga memberinya nama, katanya, "Seorang anak laki-laki telah lahir bagi Naomi." Dan mereka menamainya Obed. Dia [adalah] ayah Isai, ayah Daud.
id.B: Perempuan-perempuan tetangga memberinya nama. "Naomi mendapat seorang anak laki-laki!" kata mereka, dan mereka menamainya Obed. Dialah ayah Isai, ayah Daud.
id.R: Perempuan-perempuan yang tinggal di dekat Naomi memberi nama kepada anak itu. Mereka berkata, "Naomi mempunyai seorang anak laki-laki!" Mereka menamainya Obed. Kelak Obed menjadi ayah Isai, dan Isai adalah ayah Raja Daud.

decisions.choice: a son born to Naomi: the heir of her family
decisions.reason: Ruth bore the child, but as Mahlon's heir he belongs to the family of Elimelech and Naomi (verses 5, 10). The women speak of him as Naomi's son, the one who carries on her husband's line.

decisions.choice: Obed: "one who serves"
decisions.reason: The name comes from the verb "to serve" or "to worship". It may be short for a longer name such as Obadiah, "servant of the LORD".

decisions.choice: the neighbor women gave him a name: an unusual naming
decisions.reason: In the Bible the parents usually name a child (Genesis 30; 1 Samuel 1:20). Only here do the women of the neighborhood do it, as the town shares Naomi's joy. The "calling of a name" (verses 11, 14) now comes true.

decisions.choice: the father of Jesse, the father of David: where the story leads
decisions.reason: David's name is the last word of the verse. The loyalty of Ruth, Naomi and Boaz in the dark days of the judges (1:1) prepares the way for Israel's king. This is the first time David is named in the Bible.

decisions.choice: King David
decisions.reason: Readable adds "King" so young readers know who David is.

decisions.choice: "Obedi", "Yese", "Daudi", and in verses 18-22 "Peresi", "Hesroni", "Ramu", "Aminadabu", "Nashoni", "Salmoni", as in Matthew 1:3-6
decisions.reason: The New Testament already prints this family line in Swahili; the names here take the same forms, so that a reader can follow Ruth's line into the genealogy of Jesus. Literal keeps "Salma" in verse 20, where the Hebrew spells the name so.

decisions.choice: "Ô-bết", "Gie-sê", "Đa-vít"
decisions.reason: The forms published in Matthew 1:5–6, which the Joshua–Ruth terms note says win.

decisions.choice: Obede, Jessé, Davi
decisions.reason: The usual Brazilian forms, as in Matthew 1:5-6 in Portuguese; "as vizinhas" keeps the feminine of the Hebrew (m3) in one word.

decisions.choice: "ओबेद", "यिशै", "दाऊद" (as Matthew 1:5-6)
decisions.reason: The names keep the forms of Matthew 1 in this translation, so the end of Ruth and the start of Matthew read as one family line.

decisions.choice: Obed "オベド", Jesse "エッサイ", David "ダビデ", as MAT 1:5-6
decisions.reason: NT forms.

decisions.choice: "Obed", "Isai", "Daud"
decisions.reason: "Isai" and "Daud" are the glossary forms; "Obed" is the Hebrew name as the Indonesian church writes it. Added to the glossary.

source.text: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ תּוֹלְד֣וֹת פָּ֔רֶץ פֶּ֖רֶץ הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־חֶצְרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And these [are the] generations of Perez: Perez fathered Hezron;

en.L: And these [are] the generations of Perez: Perez fathered Hezron.
en.B: These are the descendants of Perez. Perez fathered Hezron.
en.R: Here is the family line from Perez to David. Perez was Hezron's father.

sw.L: Na hivi [ndivyo] vizazi vya Peresi: Peresi alimzaa Hesroni.
sw.B: Hawa ndio wazao wa Peresi. Peresi alimzaa Hesroni.
sw.R: Hii ndiyo orodha ya jamaa kutoka Peresi mpaka Daudi. Peresi alikuwa baba wa Hesroni.

es.L: Y estas [son] las generaciones de Fares: Fares engendró a Hezrón.
es.B: Estos son los descendientes de Fares. Fares fue padre de Hezrón.
es.R: Esta es la línea familiar de Fares hasta David. Fares fue el padre de Hezrón.

fr.L: Et voici les générations de Pérès : Pérès engendra Hesron.
fr.B: Voici la descendance de Pérès. Pérès engendra Hesron.
fr.R: Voici la liste de la famille, de Pérès jusqu’à David. Pérès a été le père de Hesron.

vi.L: Đây [là] dòng dõi của Pha-rê: Pha-rê sinh Ếch-rôm.
vi.B: Đây là dòng dõi của Pha-rê. Pha-rê sinh Ếch-rôm.
vi.R: Đây là dòng họ từ Pha-rê đến Đa-vít. Pha-rê là cha của Ếch-rôm.

ko.L: 베레스의 계보는 이러하다. 베레스는 헤스론을 낳았고,
ko.B: 베레스의 자손은 이러하다. 베레스는 헤스론을 낳았다.
ko.R: 베레스부터 다윗까지의 집안 계보는 이러하다. 베레스는 헤스론의 아버지였다.

pt.L: E estas [são] as gerações de Perez: Perez gerou Hezrom.
pt.B: Estes são os descendentes de Perez. Perez foi pai de Hezrom.
pt.R: Esta é a linhagem da família, de Perez até Davi. Perez foi o pai de Hezrom.

am.L: የፋሬስም ትውልድ ይህ ነው፤ ፋሬስ ኤስሮንን ወለደ።
am.B: የፋሬስ ዘሮች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ፋሬስ ኤስሮንን ወለደ።
am.R: ከፋሬስ እስከ ዳዊት ያለው የቤተሰብ ሐረግ ይህ ነው። ፋሬስ የኤስሮን አባት ነበረ።

hi.L: और फिरिस की वंशावली यह [है]: फिरिस ने हिस्रोन को उत्पन्न किया।
hi.B: फिरिस के वंशज ये हैं। फिरिस हिस्रोन का पिता हुआ।
hi.R: फिरिस से दाऊद तक का वंश यह है। फिरिस हिस्रोन का पिता था।

ru.L: И вот родословие Фареса: Фарес родил Есрома.
ru.B: Вот потомки Фареса. Фарес был отцом Есрома.
ru.R: Вот род, который ведёт от Фареса к Давиду. Фарес был отцом Есрома.

uk.L: І ось родовід Фареса: Фарес породив Есрома.
uk.B: Ось нащадки Фареса. Фарес породив Есрома.
uk.R: Ось родовід від Фареса до Давида. Фарес був батьком Есрома.

ja.L: さて、これらはペレツの系図である。ペレツはヘツロンをもうけた。
ja.B: ペレツの子孫は次のとおりである。ペレツはヘツロンの父となった。
ja.R: ペレツからダビデまでの家系は、次のとおりです。ペレツはヘツロンの父でした。

id.L: Dan inilah riwayat keturunan Peres: Peres memperanakkan Hezron.
id.B: Inilah keturunan Peres. Peres menjadi ayah Hezron.
id.R: Inilah silsilah keluarga dari Peres sampai Daud. Peres adalah ayah Hezron.

decisions.choice: these are the generations of: the heading of a family record
decisions.reason: The same heading opens the family records of Genesis (Genesis 2:4; 5:1; 11:27; 25:19; 37:2). It sets the story of Ruth among the great family histories of Israel. The same line, from Perez to David, appears again in 1 Chronicles 2:4-15 and in Matthew 1:3-6, which takes it on to Jesus and names Tamar, Rahab and Ruth among the mothers.

decisions.choice: ten generations from Perez to David
decisions.reason: The list names ten men, from Perez to David, with Boaz in the seventh place. Ancient family lists often counted in such set patterns and could leave out names; the list traces the line, not every generation. Hezron went down to Egypt with Jacob (Genesis 46:12).

decisions.choice: from Perez to David
decisions.reason: Readable says at once where the list leads.

decisions.choice: "engendra" (L, B); "a été le père de" (R); the names as in Matthew 1:3-6 ("Hesron", "Ram", "Amminadab", "Nahshôn", "Salmon", "Jessé")
decisions.reason: The genealogy keeps the forms of the same names in Matthew 1 and Luke 3 in this translation, as the terms note asks where a name is already published. Readable says "a été le père de", as the English Readable says "was ... father".

decisions.choice: "Ếch-rôm" for Hezron, and the other names of verses 18–22 as Matthew 1:3–6
decisions.reason: The Joshua–Ruth terms note says the New Testament form wins where a name is already published; the genealogy in Matthew gives these names in Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: "Đây là dòng dõi của" for "these are the generations of"
decisions.reason: The heading the Genesis note sets for *toledot* at Literal; Balanced keeps it, since the list that follows is a plain line of descent.

decisions.choice: "~의 계보는 이러하다" for "these are the generations of"
decisions.reason: As the terms of this translation set for the *toledot* formula in Genesis; the genealogy uses the forms of the names already published in Matthew 1:3-6.

decisions.choice: Perez, Hezrom; gerou (L), foi pai de (B), foi o pai de (R)
decisions.reason: For the list (verses 18-22): the names keep the forms of Genesis 38 and 46 and Numbers 26 in Portuguese (Perez, Hezrom) and of Matthew 1:3-6 (Rão, Aminadabe, Naassom, Salmom, Boaz, Obede, Jessé, Davi). "Gerou" is the Literal verb, as in Matthew 1 in Portuguese; Balanced and Readable say "foi pai de".

decisions.choice: the names of the line from Perez to David as in Matthew 1:3-6 in the Amharic New Testament ("ፋሬስ", "አሚናዳብ", "ነአሶን", "ሰልሞን", "ቦዔዝ", "ኢዮቤድ", "እሴይ", "ዳዊት"), except Hezron "ኤስሮን" (Genesis 46:12) and Ram "ራም"
decisions.reason: A reader who turns from Ruth 4 to Matthew 1 should meet the same men under the same names. Where Matthew's form comes from the Greek and differs from the Hebrew (Esrom, Aram for Hezron, Ram), the Amharic follows the Hebrew and the form the Pentateuch already uses. The genealogy is "Y ወለደ" (Literal, Balanced), as in Genesis, and "የY አባት ነበረ" (Readable).

decisions.choice: "X ने Y को उत्पन्न किया" (Literal); "X Y का पिता हुआ" (Balanced); "X Y का पिता था" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The list formula of Matthew 1 in this translation, as the history-books note settles for genealogies; names are those of Matthew 1:3-6 ("फिरिस", "हिस्रोन", "अम्मीनादाब", "नहशोन", "सलमोन").

decisions.choice: "родил" (Literal); "был отцом" (Balanced, Readable); the names as in Matthew 1:3-6
decisions.reason: The list (verses 18-22) uses Matthew 1's formula in this translation: "родил" at Literal, "был отцом" at Balanced (with a dash for the repeated verb, "Арам — Аминадава") and Readable, and its names: Фарес, Есром, Арам, Аминадав, Наассон, Салмон, Вооз, Овид, Иессей, Давид.

decisions.choice: "породив" (L, B), "був батьком" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced use the verb of Matthew 1:2-6 at Literal; Readable says "був батьком", as Matthew's Balanced and the English Readable.

ru.R: Овид был отцом Иессея, а Иессей был отцом Давида.

uk.L: І Овид породив Єссея, а Єссей породив Давида.
uk.B: Овид породив Єссея, а Єссей породив Давида.
uk.R: Овид був батьком Єссея, а Єссей — батьком Давида.

ja.L: そしてオベドはエッサイをもうけ、エッサイはダビデをもうけた。
ja.B: オベドはエッサイの父となり、エッサイはダビデの父となった。
ja.R: オベドはエッサイの父で、エッサイはダビデの父でした。

id.L: Dan Obed memperanakkan Isai, dan Isai memperanakkan Daud.
id.B: Obed menjadi ayah Isai, dan Isai menjadi ayah Daud.
id.R: Obed adalah ayah Isai, dan Isai adalah ayah Daud.

decisions.choice: Jesse fathered David: the book ends with Israel's king
decisions.reason: The book closes on David's name, as verse 17 does. The LORD's care for one widowed family in Bethlehem was part of his care for all Israel, and for the line of the king through whom he would keep his promises (2 Samuel 7:12-16).
